evals.prompt: Give me story ideas for a 90-second animated short about a kid and a broken kite.
evals.expected_output: 3-5 genuinely different concepts with logline, hook, engine, central question, ending direction and producibility, plus a recommendation.
expectations: At least three concepts are given and they differ in protagonist, conflict or genre, not just setting
Each concept has a logline naming protagonist, goal, obstacle and stakes
Each concept has a producibility note (characters, locations)
A single recommended concept is named with a reason

evals.prompt: Develop this into a full story: a retired astronaut secretly builds a rocket in her garden to see Earth one last time. 2 minutes, drama.
evals.expected_output: A story.md with characters (want/need/flaw/arc), structure choice, causal beat outline with values, setups/payoffs, ending and rubric.
expectations: Characters have want, need, flaw or wound, and an arc from -> to
The beat outline links beats with 'therefore' or 'but'
Each beat states a value change before -> after
A setups and payoffs table exists with no orphan setups
Beat durations sum to roughly 120 seconds

evals.prompt: Add a plot twist to my story where the detective turns out to be the thief.
evals.expected_output: A twist plan with at least two fair visible clues placed before the reveal, what it recontextualizes, and what the protagonist does next.
expectations: At least two clues are planted in beats before the reveal
Clues are visual or audible things a camera can capture
The response states what the twist recontextualizes
The response states how the protagonist acts on the twist
